propositions: Packaged prose guides cite criterion IDs inline without automated coupling to the criteria registry, allowing criterion text to change silently while guide claims become stale or contradictory
A citation PIN manifest mechanism must detect when a cited criterion's authoritative text changes, forcing re-verification and re-pinning rather than allowing unnoticed semantic drift

The gate must extract citations using vocabulary-only matching against the closed criterion-id set at word boundaries, independent of guide markup or structure, so ordinary prose edits do not trigger failures
The pin manifest is generated into src/rebar/_guides/criterion-pins.json as a derived artifact and validated by composition into the existing validate-routing gate without a new CI step
Citation extraction must report unknown citations, stale pins, orphan pins, and missing manifests, and must cover all guides in AUTHOR_GUIDES, not only the plan guide
